item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena drops a small steel nail and a large wooden log into a tub of water at home.

The tiny nail sinks but the heavy log floats.

What is the correct explanation?

options.A: The nail sinks because small objects are always heavier than large objects.
options.B: Steel has a greater density than water, so the nail sinks, while wood has a lower density than water, so the log floats.
options.C: The log floats because bigger objects always float, whatever material they are made of.
options.D: The nail sinks because its surface is smooth, and smooth objects always sink.
